doc:
### PROPOSAL-03 — Comic Book / Graphic Novel - **slug**: `comic-book` - **Vibe**: Bold black ink outlines, halftone dot fields, and CMYK primary pop on pulp paper — every stat reads like a panel from a graphic novel. - **Best for**: Earnings dashboard and campaign bursts — big, dramatic numbers. Adjectives: loud, dramatic, unmistakable. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f6f1e3` | Pulp-paper canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#fff9eb` | Hovered/raised paper highlight | | `--border-subtle` | `#cfc8b6` | Light ink hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#141414` | Heavy ink outlines (2-3px) | | `--border-focus` | `#e6343c` | Comic-red focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#141414` | Ink-black headings and body | | `--text-secondary` | `#3a3a3a` | Standard body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6e6757` | Captions, dates, fine print | | `--color-action` | `#e6343c` | CMYK-red primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#c92a31` | Action hover (darker red) | | `--color-earnings` | `#0a9d4e` | Comic green for earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#0b8a44` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#2f6bff` | CMYK-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb302` | Comic-yellow warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#8c1c22` | Dark blood-red destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(230, 52, 60, 0.14)` | Halftone-red tint behind icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(10, 157, 78, 0.14)` | Halftone-green tint behind icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(47, 107, 255, 0.14)` | Halftone-blue tint behind icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Bangers", "Archivo Black", sans-serif` — always uppercase, `letter-spacing: 0.02em`, used only for KPI numerals, section headers, and CTA labels. Sans: `"Archivo", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"Space Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps. Numbers are `tabular-nums` and deliberately heavy. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp and inked — cards and buttons at 2px radius; the ink border is 2-3px solid `--border-default` plus a 1px inner white "frame" (double-line comic panel). Buttons may tilt -1deg on hover for a "paste-up" feel. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: 3px ink border + solid pop fill, uppercase Bangers label, hard offset ink shadow (4px, no blur). Primary = red fill with white bold text (large text, passes AA). Secondary = white fill + ink outline. Focus = 3px `--border-focus` outline. - **Cards**: Paper-white fill, 3px ink outline + hard offset shadow, header banded with a halftone dot strip (CSS `repeating-radial-gradient`). The KPI numeral sits on the halftone field like a panel caption. - **Badges/Status**: Sticker-style pills with ink border and halftone background; publishing = pulsing "burst" starburst; failed = red sticker with white text. - **Tables**: Alternating white/cream rows with ink column rules; header row is a red banner strip with white uppercase labels. Hover = 2px left ink tick. - **Forms/Inputs**: "Lined-paper" fields — only a 2px ink baseline under the input; focus = red baseline + small star burst in the corner. - **Loading**: A comic "POW" starburst that pulses and scales in a 3-frame cycle; determinate progress = speech-bubble meter filling with dots. - **Signature detail**: The halftone dot field + heavy ink outlines on every panel — the unmistakable print-comic texture. - **Motion & Animation**: Fast and theatrical: entries "POP" in with `scale(0.85) -> scale(1.05) -> scale(1)` over 200ms with a slight rotate; buttons smash down 2px on `:active`. Turbo Stream inserts inherit the POP. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS THIS MONTH $8,240 +22%
```
